hypothesis: The V18 public improvement came from pitcher-by-batter-hand and pitcher-by-pressure-by-batter-hand effects that survived a strict next-season transfer. Feeding the same frozen conditional state into an independently trained direct outcome model may capture the signal without an ineligible signed residual correction.

immutable_parent.drop_features: identical to exact_C, including raw pitcher_id and the 40 pitch-class-specific e58 columns

single_change: append temporal_stable_joint numeric features; every other exact_C setting is unchanged

temporal_stable_joint.training_encoding: for each training season, use that season's source table with the row's own target removed
temporal_stable_joint.validation_encoding: use the latest completed regular-season source table only

source_protocol.selection: maximize min(2020 R raw gain, 2021 R raw gain); ties use mean R gain, CI lower bound, then smaller gamma
source_protocol.on_fail: close this family without generating 2022, 2023, or 2024 candidate predictions
source_protocol.on_pass: freeze gamma and implementation hash before opening later folds
